name: Wife's Temptation
source:
This story is about a couple and focused mainly on female character, Sofi. Sofi is a pretty, beautifully-shaped married woman living with her husband, Bob. Sofi has been a bad girl for a long time at school, at college enjoying her free time fully and fucking the best alpha men. However, she stopped all of this after marriage. Something changed after John's visit. From now on, you will decide whether she will survive against these temptations or surround to passion.​

[Edited from F95zone]
